facts.rationale: Corrects entity-count wording and captures the exact inclusive mode-reset boundary rather than calling it merely out-of-range repair.
facts.value: Priority is Back, shoulder triggers, X/Y, then up/down; L takes precedence over R when both are present. X/Y is rejected with sound 3 when GetNameCount() is zero. Otherwise it toggles fighter/name mode and resets scroll_offset on return to fighter mode whenever scroll_offset + 10 >= 21, including offset 11. Cursor rows range from 0 through 9. At the top, upward movement decrements a nonzero offset; at the bottom, downward movement increments the offset by one only if scroll_offset + 10 is below 21 statistic categories in fighter mode or 24 in name mode. These limits count categories, not ranked entities.

facts.value: Constructs the third VS Records subsection, the rankings view: a ten-category label window and selection popup accompany up to five ranked fighters or saved names for the selected statistic. Name-mode play-frequency categories use aggregate fighter results. The initializer populates this presentation and enables interactive navigation.

facts.rationale: Replaces misleading full-window-step wording with the one-category scrolling behavior actually implemented.
facts.value: The forward arrow is visible when scroll_offset + 10 is below the category limit, 24 in name mode or 21 otherwise; this means at least one additional category can be revealed by a one-row scroll, not that a full-window jump remains. The backward arrow is visible when scroll_offset is nonzero. Each arrow's animation is updated before its visibility is tested, including when it will be hidden.

facts.rationale: Replaces ambiguous terminal-state wording with exact local guards and preserves scheduler-sensitive lifetime semantics.
facts.value: Initialization assigns anim_state = 1 and scroll_offset = 0, copies the menu identifier and low-byte cursor selection from shared menu state, and loads fighter/name mode from game rules. While menu mode is 0x1E and sub-state is 2, Think updates arrows. If mode remains 0x1E but sub-state changes, it requests direct GObj destruction. If mode changes away from 0x1E, it replaces Think with the exit-animation callback and hides JObj slot 2; that callback requests destruction when slot 1 reaches the configured end frame. Direct destruction requests may be deferred by the GObj scheduler.
